summary: P0 bug fix VERIFIED. The Instagram icon crash on the store detail page is resolved. Tested /store/store_1, /store/store_2 (Urban Style Boutique, which has instagram in contact), and /store/store_3. All 3 stores load without any ErrorBoundary/'Something went wrong'/'Element type is invalid' error. All 3 tabs (Catálogo, Horários & Local, Avaliações) render correctly on every store. The 'Contatos & Redes' section on store_2's Info tab now renders the Instagram handle (@urbanstyle) using the AtSign icon without crashing. Regression tests passed: channel-whatsapp-btn, channel-phone-btn, channel-directions-btn are all visible and tappable; review submission flow (login as consumer -> reviews tab -> open modal -> select rating 4 -> type comment -> submit) works end-to-end and the new review appears in the list (review count went from 1 to 2, rating updated 4.8 -> 4.5).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' emitted repeatedly (logoBadge style uses shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius at /app/frontend/app/store/[id].tsx:721-725). Non-blocking but recommend migrating to boxShadow for RN Web compatibility.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix (Instagram -> AtSign in /app/frontend/app/store/[id].tsx) is fully verified across store_1, store_2 and store_3 on mobile viewport 390x844. Review submission regression also passes with the consumer demo user. Only leftover cosmetic concern is deprecated shadow* style props warning (non-blocking).
rca_of_issue: Root cause: lucide-react-native no longer exports the 'Instagram' named icon in the installed version. Importing it resulted in `Instagram === undefined`, and rendering <Instagram/> inside the Contatos & Redes block on the Info tab triggered React's 'Element type is invalid: expected a string ... but got: undefined' which was caught by the top-level ErrorBoundary as 'Something went wrong' in StoreDetailScreen. Fix: replaced the import and JSX usage with the valid `AtSign` icon (kept same size and instagram color #E1306C). Reproduction is no longer possible on any of the three seeded stores.
